fee_notes: $100,000 upon signing Master Franchise Agreement; $150,000 in 120 monthly installments of $1,250 commencing first month after effective date (0% interest unless late, then 18% per annum compounded annually). Installments credited by 50% of Net Payments received and $25,000 of each Net Franchise Fee. Plus Master Franchise Brand Fund Payment of $2,000 upon signing. All non-refundable.
